title: Incorrect conversion from USD to asset during redemption
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  In the deposit() function, the conversion from asset amount to USD value is performed by multiplying the spot rate: `        uint256 usdValue = escrow.getRate(details.spotMarket).mulWadDown(amount * scaler); ` in the redeem() function, the conversion from USD back to asset is incorrectly also performed via multiplication: `amount = escrow.getRate(details.spotMarket).mulWadDown(usdAmount); `  This causes the user to receive more tokens than they originally deposited, leading to value inflation.
